## Define Gene Sets
```{r}
Gene_Sets <- list()
# Poon NI 2023
xl <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Poonetal_SuppTable7_barrTRM_v_Other_DEGs.xlsx", sheet = 1)
xl <- xl[-1] 
xl_up <- xl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Tissue", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(JE|LG|SK)_(.*)"
  ) %>% subset(logfoldchang > 0.75 & pvals_adj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(names) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Tissue) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()  

xl_up <- unique(xl_up$names)
xl_up <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(xl_up)))
xl_up <- paste0(xl_up, "+")

xl_down <- xl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Tissue", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(JE|LG|SK)_(.*)"
  ) %>% subset(logfoldchang < -0.75 & pvals_adj <0.05) %>%
  group_by(names) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Tissue) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()  
# The data have been subset to include significant genes only present in 2 or more organs

xl_down <- unique(xl_down$names)
xl_down <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(xl_down)))
xl_down <- paste0(xl_down, "-")

Poon_2023 <- c(xl_up, xl_down)
  

# Mackay 2016
Mackay_2016 <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_sig_Mackay2016_suppFig13.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# Scott 2025 - Genes_Up
Scott_2025_Icos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 1)
Scott_2025_NoIcos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 3)
Scott_2025_up <- unique(c(Scott_2025_Icos$Icoshi_Trm_up_genes, Scott_2025_NoIcos$Icoslo_Trm_up_genes))
Scott_2025_up <- paste0(Scott_2025_up, "+")

# Scott 2025 - Genes_Down
Scott_2025_Icos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 2)
Scott_2025_NoIcos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 4)
Scott_2025_down <- unique(c(Scott_2025_Icos$Icoshi_Trm_down_genes, Scott_2025_NoIcos$Icoslo_Trm_down_genes))
Scott_2025_down <- paste0(Scott_2025_down, "-")

Scott_2025 <- c(Scott_2025_up, Scott_2025_down)

# Jaiswal
Jaiswal_2022 <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_sig_Jaiswal2022_supp1.xlsx", sheet = 1)
up <- c(Jaiswal_2022$Exclusive_high, Jaiswal_2022$non_exclusive_up )
up <- na.omit(up)
up <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(up)))



down <- subset(Jaiswal_2022, Exclusive_down != "NA")$Exclusive_down
down <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(down)))
Jaiswal_2022 <- c(paste0(up, "+"), paste0(down, "-") )
  
Gene_Sets[["Poon_2023"]] <- Poon_2023
Gene_Sets[["Jaiswal_2022"]] <- Jaiswal_2022
Gene_Sets[["Mackay_2016"]] <- Mackay_2016
Gene_Sets[["Scott_2025"]] <- Scott_2025

Other_Sets <- list()

# Utzschneider NAture Immunology 2020
xl <- read.xlsx("../../../../../My_Analysis/reference_data/Gene_Signatures/Utzschneider_NatImmunology_2020.xlsx", sheet = 5, startRow = 2)
Other_Sets[["TEX_Utzschneider_2020"]] <- as.vector(xl$Symbol)

Other_Sets[["TCR_Elliot_2021"]] <- as.vector(c("Nr4a1", "Nr4a2", "Nr4a3", "Cd69", "Tnf", "Irf4", "Irf8", "Egr2", "Tnfsf4", "Il2", "Il2ra", "Cd40lg", "Pdcd1", "Tbx21", "Ifng", "Gzmb", "Il12rb2", "Malt1", "Mt1", "Mt2", "Il21", "Rora", "Rorc", "Ctla4", "Icos", "Maf", "Il10", "Nfil3", "Tigit", "Lag3", "Cd3g", "Cd3e", "Lck", "Rasgrp1", "Gata3", "Bhlhe40", "Eomes", "Runx3"))
```

## Text base
```{r}
pt_to_mm <- function(pt) pt / 2.95
txt_pt <- 10
txt_mm <- txt_pt / 2.95
cex_base <- txt_pt / 12
```

```{r}
lvl <- c(
  "CD4 TN",
  "CD4 TSM",
  "CD4 TH1DM",
  "CD4 Regulatory",
  "CD8 TN",
  "CD8 TSM",
  "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM",
  "DN TSM",
  "Proliferating"
  )

lab <- c(
  "CD4 TN"            = expression("CD4 TN"),
  "CD4 TSM"           = expression("CD4 TSM"),
  "CD4 TH1DM"         = expression("CD4 " * T[H1] * DM),
  "CD4 TCTLDM"        = expression("CD4 " * T[CTL] * DM),
  "CD4 Regulatory"    = expression("CD4 " * T[reg]),
  "CD8 TN"              = expression("CD8 TN"),
  "CD8 TSM"             = expression("CD8 TSM"),
  "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM"       = expression("CD8 " * T[c1*"-"*CTL] * DM),
  "DN TSM"           = expression("DN TSM"),
  "Proliferating"  = expression("Proliferating"))

```

#-----Cluster Description Dot------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
feat <- list(
    Lin = c("Cd4","Cd8a"),
    Naive = c("Ccr7", "Sell","Tcf7", "Klf2"),
    Activation = c("Cd44", "Cd69","Ifng"),
    Cytotoxic = c( "Gzmb","Nkg7","Runx3", "Ccl5"),
    Treg = c( "Foxp3","Il2ra", "Ctla4"))

Dot <- seu_gene_sets_dot(Tc,
    feat,                         # named list: list("Group A"=c("G1","G2(+)"), "Group B"=c(...))
    group_by = "celltype",              # meta.data column (like DotPlot(group.by=))
    assay    = NULL,                   # NULL => DefaultAssay(seu)
    use_scaled_for_fill = TRUE,        # TRUE: fill = avg.exp.scaled; FALSE: avg.exp (raw)
    # aesthetics (DotPlot-like)
    size_range   = c(1, 5),           # bubble size range
    size_breaks  = c(5, 20, 40),  # % expressing
    size_limits  = c(0, 100),          # % expressing limits
    fill_limits  = c(-1, 1),           # when use_scaled_for_fill=TRUE
    fill_palette = c("blue", "lightgrey", "darkred"),
    x_label      = "",
    base_size    = txt_pt,
    x_angle      = 45,
    x_text_size  = txt_pt,
    y_text_size  = txt_pt,
    x_title_size = txt_pt,
    bracket_text_size = txt_mm,
    bracket_tick = 0.25,
    # layout/headroom controls
    y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
    y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
    y_bracket_offset    = 0.80,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
    y_label_offset      = 0.18,        # text above bracket baseline
    plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),  # top, right, bottom, left
    # NEW: clustering options
    cluster_groups = F,            # reorder rows (clusters) by hclut
    cluster_genes  = "within_group",
    dist_method    = "euclidean",
    hclust_method  = "complete") + theme(text = element_text(family = "Times")) + scale_y_discrete(limits = lvl, labels = lab) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

Dot_plot <- Dot + NoLegend()
```

#----What cells are TRM----
```{r}
DefaultAssay(Tc_8) <- "RNA"
#Assign quartile ratings
q <- quantile(Tc_8$TRM_Avg_UCell, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a new metadata column with TRMhi / TRMint / TRMlo classification
Tc_8$TRM_group <- cut(
  Tc_8$TRM_Avg_UCell,
  breaks = c(-Inf, q[1], q[2], Inf),
  labels = c("TRMlo", "TRMint", "TRMhi"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

table(Tc_8$TRM_group, Tc_8$Tissue)
```

#----Which genes drive TRM signature? ----
```{r}
  # subset to this celltype and keep only TRMhi / TRMlo
  sub <- subset(
    Tc_8,
    subset = TRM_group %in% c("TRMhi", "TRMlo"))

  Idents(sub) <- "TRM_group"

  res <- FindAllMarkers(sub, assay="RNA", slot = "scale.data",
      logfc.threshold = 0.25,
      min.pct = 0.25,
      test.use = "MAST",
      only.pos = F)
  
  res <- res[res$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
```

## Identification of signature genes vs. non-signature genes
```{r}
sig_genes <- res[res$gene %in% genes_2plus, ]
missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_2plus, res$gene)
missing_genes_df <- data.frame(gene = missing_genes)

sig_genes_absent <- subset(genes_2plus, !(genes_2plus %in% res$gene))
NOTsig_genes <- res[!c(res$gene %in% genes_2plus), ]
down <- subset(res, cluster == "TRMlo" & avg_log2FC > 0.25)
```

```{r}
Hum_genes <- hum_TRM
Ms_genes <- ms_TRM$gene

Hum_genes  <- unique(na.omit(Hum_genes))
Ms_genes <- unique(na.omit(Ms_genes))


comparison_genes <- list(
  Human  = Hum_genes,
  Mouse = Ms_genes
)

fit <- euler(comparison_genes)

counts  <- fit$original.values
percent <- round(100 * counts / sum(counts), 1)
labels  <- paste0(counts, "\n(", percent, "%)")


venn_plot <- plot(
  fit,
  fills = list(
    fill  = c("#ffca06", "#20A73C"),
    alpha = 0.5
  ),
  labels = list(font = 2, cex = cex_base),
  quantities = list(
    labels = labels,
    font   = 2,
    cex    = cex_base
  ),
  edges = TRUE,
  main  = ""
)

svglite(file, width = 6, height = 3)
venn_plot

```

```{r}
features_up <- unique(c(
"Fth1","Jund", "Gpx4", "Cd69","Bhlhe40","Aldoa", "Rgs1", "Nr4a1", "Nr4a2", "Bhlhe40", "Fosl2", "Nr4a3", "Ifng", "Xcl1", "Cxcr6", "Klf6", "Cd69", "Vim", "Rora", "Brd2", "Dnaja1", "Junb", "Jun", "Icos", "Cxcr4", "Arf4"
))

features_up_signature <- intersect(features_up, genes_2plus)
features_up_notsig    <- setdiff(features_up, genes_2plus)

features_down <- c("CCr7","Sell","Tcf7","S1pr1","Klf2")


genes <- c(features_up_notsig, features_up_signature, features_down)

# --- Subset to genes of interest ---
df <- res[res$gene %in% genes, ]

# --- Wide matrix (one value per cluster x gene) ---
mat <- acast(
  df, cluster ~ gene,
  value.var = "avg_log2FC",
  fun.aggregate = mean, na.rm = TRUE
)

stopifnot("TRMhi" %in% rownames(mat), "TRMlo" %in% rownames(mat))

# Order genes within groups using TRMhi row
trmhi <- mat["TRMhi", ]

TRM_up_notsig_ordered    <- names(sort(trmhi[features_up_notsig],    decreasing = TRUE))
TRM_up_signature_ordered <- names(sort(trmhi[features_up_signature], decreasing = TRUE))
TRM_down_ordered         <- names(sort(trmhi[features_down],         decreasing = FALSE))  # most negative first

genes_ordered <- c(TRM_up_notsig_ordered, TRM_up_signature_ordered, TRM_down_ordered)
genes_ordered <- genes_ordered[genes_ordered %in% colnames(mat)]  

mat <- mat[c("TRMhi", "TRMlo"), genes_ordered, drop = FALSE]

# Column groups for split
group_levels <- c("putative", "established", "down")

col_groups <- dplyr::case_when(
  genes_ordered %in% features_up_notsig    ~ "putative",
  genes_ordered %in% features_up_signature ~ "established",
  genes_ordered %in% features_down         ~ "down",
  TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
)
col_groups <- factor(col_groups, levels = group_levels)

column_titles <- c(
  expression(atop("Human Plaque", T[R] * "M Genes")),
  expression(atop("Established",     T[R] * "M Genes")),
  expression(atop("Genes down in",   T[R] * "M-hi"))
)

# Heatmap colours
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1.5, 0, 1.5), c("blue", "white", "red"))

row_labels <- c(
  expression(T[RM]-hi),
  expression(T[RM]-lo)
)

# colour vector, aligned to the heatmap columns
col_lab_col <- ifelse(colnames(mat) %in% Common_Trm, "purple", "black")
```

```{r}
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  height = nrow(mat) * unit(5, "mm"),
  width  = ncol(mat) * unit(4, "mm"),
  name   = "avg_log2FC",
  col    = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_title = column_titles,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_labels = row_labels,
  row_names_side = "left",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_split = col_groups,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt, rot = 45, fontfamily = "Times"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt, rot = 45, col = col_lab_col, fontfamily = "Times"),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt, fontfamily = "Times"),
  border = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Expression",
    direction = "horizontal",
    position = "center",

)
```
